Apartment for Rent in Kitsilano, Vancouver
Yorkville North at 1888 York Avenue is a property located in Vancouver’s sought-after Kitsilano neighbourhood, just minutes from Kitsilano Beach and the waterfront. This desirable Westside location offers convenient access to West 4th Avenue, Granville Island, Vanier Park and Downtown Vancouver, with shopping, dining, recreation and transit nearby.

Kitsilano Beach and the waterfront are just a short walk from the property, while nearby West 4th Avenue offers a wide selection of shops, cafés, restaurants and everyday conveniences. With beaches, parks, the Seawall and Granville Island all nearby, Yorkville North offers exceptional access to some of Vancouver’s most popular destinations.

SUITE & BUILDING FEATURES
Suites feature spacious floorplans, in-suite laundry, generous private decks and panoramic views of Burrard Inlet, the city and surrounding mountains. Secured underground parking is also available.

WALKABLE & CONNECTED LOCATION
Yorkville North offers an exceptionally walkable and bike-friendly Kitsilano location, with a Walk Score of 97 (Walker’s Paradise), Bike Score of 99 (Biker’s Paradise) and Transit Score of 72 (Excellent Transit). Shopping, dining, recreation, transit and some of Vancouver’s most popular destinations are all nearby.

Nearby amenities and destinations include:
• Henry Hudson Elementary School (1 min walk)
• Kitsilano Beach (7 min walk)
• Kitsilano Pool (10 min walk)
• West 4th Avenue shops, cafés & restaurants (10 min walk)
• Whole Foods Market (10 min walk)
• Vanier Park (12 min walk)
• Hadden Park (15 min walk)
• Museum of Vancouver (15 min walk)
• H.R. MacMillan Space Centre (15 min walk)
• Granville Island (15 min walk)
• Downtown Vancouver (10 min drive / 10 min bike)
